about: A backend pagination repair must plan the requested behavior and leave the saved presentation decision and assets alone. The production interaction duty is conditional on the request/item naming interactions; this request deliberately has no UI cue. This is a scope and routing control, not a visual-quality test.

planted.what: The plan addresses the requested partial-last-page pagination defect with a concrete criterion.
planted.signature: paginate plus last/partial/page result in a criterion

controls.what: The accepted presentation record and theme assets stay unchanged and are not selected as implementation work.
Planning makes no product-tree edits outside its workflow records.

render.packet_not_contains: first UI planning reads the UI visual-direction guide
